WITH match_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        m.season,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_api_id 
             WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN m.away_team_api_id 
        END as winning_team_api_id
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        winning_team_api_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_wins
    FROM match_wins
    GROUP BY league_id, winning_team_api_id
),
min_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        league_id,
        MIN(total_wins) as min_wins
    FROM team_wins
    GROUP BY league_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT 
        tw.league_id,
        tw.winning_team_api_id,
        tw.total_wins,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.winning_team_api_id) as rn
    FROM team_wins tw
    JOIN min_wins mw ON tw.league_id = mw.league_id AND tw.total_wins = mw.min_wins
)
SELECT 
    lw.name as league_name,
    t.team_short_name,
    rt.total_wins
FROM ranked_teams rt
JOIN League lw ON rt.league_id = lw.id
JOIN Team t ON rt.winning_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE rt.rn = 1
ORDER BY lw.name
